from pathlib import Path
import re, json
objs=[('job:j000265/j139-j140-private-key-contexts.json','store/jobs/j000265/out/j139-j140-private-key-contexts.json',['private_key']),('job:j000265/stdout.log','store/jobs/j000265/stdout.log',['private_key']),('job:j000268/coverage-sweep-hit-contexts.json','store/jobs/j000268/out/coverage-sweep-hit-contexts.json',['client_email']),('job:j000269/q13-private-key-sweep-triage.json','store/jobs/j000269/out/q13-private-key-sweep-triage.json',['infobreakage_dbkey','client_email','name_client']),('job:j000269/stdout.log','store/jobs/j000269/stdout.log',['infobreakage_dbkey','client_email','name_client']),('job:j000271/otr-file-route.json','store/jobs/j000271/out/otr-file-route.json',['private_key']),('job:j000271/stdout.log','store/jobs/j000271/stdout.log',['private_key'])]
out=[]
for ref,p,terms in objs:
 b=Path(p).read_bytes(); rec={'ref':ref,'size':len(b),'matches':[]}
 for term in terms:
  needle=term.encode().lower(); pos=0
  while (i:=b.lower().find(needle,pos))>=0:
   lo=max(0,i-90); hi=min(len(b),i+len(needle)+120)
   raw=b[lo:hi]
   txt=raw.decode('utf8','replace')

   txt=re.sub(r'(?i)(private_key.{0,45}?[:=].{0,30}?)([^,\\"\s}]{10,})',r'\1[REDACTED]',txt)
   rec['matches'].append({'needle':term,'offset':i,'context':txt})
   pos=i+len(needle)
 rec['count']=len(rec['matches']);out.append(rec)
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True))
